comment: The authority on where every shipped asset came from and what it is
licensed under. ATTRIBUTION.md is generated from this file, and the
build renders it into the site, so an asset cannot ship without its
attribution appearing in the product.
tools/check-licence-separation.mjs requires that every payload file in
this package is covered by exactly one entry here, and that every entry
names a licence, a holder and a source.
`shareAlike` is per entry, not per package. First-party assets here stay
Apache-2.0; only what derives from the BodyParts3D meshes is share-alike.
See docs/asset-licensing.md for the D1 memo and for the upstream licence
discrepancy it records.
`licenceClass` is per entry too, and never inferred: "asset", or
"asset-nc" for non-commercial content. asset-nc files live only under
`atlas.ncPayloadDirs` in package.json, which the build does not copy, so
they are absent from every default build (DOG-123 D3).
`upstreamSources` records every third-party source an entry may derive
from, with the verdict the licence memo reached on it (docs/asset-licensing.md
section 7). An entry names its inputs in `sources`; the licence check refuses
an entry that cites a source not cleared, and makes it inherit the source's
share-alike and non-commercial terms. Sources are recorded before anything
ships from them, so they are not rendered into ATTRIBUTION.md until an entry
cites them.
packageLicenceDecision: DOG-2 D1 (mesh licence), approved by the repository owner 2026-10-09; share-alike confirmed MANDATORY by the owner the same day (DOG-35)

entries.title: BD body template, BodyParts3D 4.0 adult
entries.holder: The Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS); adaptation by GStack
entries.source: Derived by tools/build-bd-template.mjs from BodyParts3D/Anatomography 4.0, 99%-polygon-reduced OBJ set (IS-A tree), isa_BP3D_4.0_obj_99.zip, https://dbarchive.biosciencedbc.jp/en/bodyparts3d/download.html
entries.attributionStatement: BodyParts3D, (c) The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution-Share Alike 2.1 Japan
entries.note: A spine centreline, per-level frames and per-level skin radii measured from 25 vertebra meshes and the skin mesh. An adaptation of the DBCLS meshes, so it is share-alike: D1 settled the inbound licence as CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan, which is what the OBJ payloads' own header comments state, and this derivative ships under CC BY-SA 4.0, the current version of the same licence with the same elements. The archive's web licence page now states CC BY 4.0 instead; the owner was shown the discrepancy and decided on 2026-10-09 that share-alike is MANDATORY, so this cannot be relicensed by a later release. See docs/asset-licensing.md section 3. No mesh vertices are redistributed here.

entries.title: BV brain-volume template, ICBM152 2009c
entries.holder: Louis Collins, McConnell Brain Imaging Centre, Montreal Neurological Institute, McGill University; adaptation by GStack
entries.source: Derived by tools/build-bv-template.mjs from the ICBM 152 non-linear 2009c asymmetric distribution, mni_icbm152_nlin_asym_09c_nifti.zip, https://www.bic.mni.mcgill.ca/~vfonov/icbm/2009/mni_icbm152_nlin_asym_09c_nifti.zip
entries.attributionStatement: Copyright (C) 1993-2004 Louis Collins, McConnell Brain Imaging Centre, Montreal Neurological Institute, McGill University.
entries.note: Six distances, one landmark and three unit vectors, measured from the distribution's own brain mask and NIfTI affine. NO IMAGE DATA from that archive is redistributed. The archive's COPYING text is reproduced verbatim inside the template's provenance block and requires only that the copyright notice travel with copies, which this entry and ATTRIBUTION.md do. Not share-alike, so this file carries no obligation onto anything that reads it. The AC-PC distance is recorded UNVERIFIED and unused - see the template's `provenance.landmarks.pc`.

entries.title: ALC-1 name index and structure coverings
entries.holder: The Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS); UBERON / OBO Foundry; adaptation by GStack
entries.source: Derived by tools/build-name-index.mjs from BodyParts3D/Anatomography 4.0 (IS-A and PART-OF trees, isa_BP3D_4.0_obj_99.zip) and from UBERON basic.obo, http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/uberon/basic.obo
entries.attributionStatement: BodyParts3D, (c) The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution-Share Alike 2.1 Japan
entries.note: names.json carries FMA concept ids and the release's own English terms, plus UBERON cross-references read from UBERON's FMA xrefs (UBERON is CC BY 3.0, which BY-SA 4.0 satisfies). coverings.json is computed from the mesh geometry, so it is an adaptation of the DBCLS meshes and share-alike follows. The brain is deliberately absent: it is a BV structure, and the owner decided on 2026-10-09 not to use Harvard-Oxford, AAL or Julich-Brain, so BV ships coordinates without names until a first-party label layer exists - see docs/asset-licensing.md section 4.

upstreamSources.title: brainproject brain model (brain.glb + manifest.json)
upstreamSources.conditions: Only per structure. The file is a compilation, and its blanket CC BY-SA 4.0 statement is no stronger than its inputs: 146 of its 437 structures carry Z-Anatomy materials whose upstream licence is undeclared or not positively known (source zanatomy-undeclared-brain-materials), and 44 cranial nerves derive from a model whose primary page declares no licence (source dundee-cranial-nerves). An entry derived from this file must also cite the source of every structure it carries. Its attribution chain omits Brainder; ours must not.
upstreamSources.evidence: LICENSE (dual: Apache-2.0 code; CC BY-SA 4.0 for brain.glb and derived metadata) and README.md 'Attribution & licence', both at the pinned commit. Per-structure materials read from the glTF JSON chunk of brain.glb. The archive digest is of GitHub's generated tarball, which GitHub does not promise is byte-stable; the per-file digests are the durable pin.

upstreamSources.title: Z-Anatomy, the libre 3D atlas of anatomy
upstreamSources.holder: Gauthier Kervyn and the Z-Anatomy contributors
upstreamSources.attributionStatement: Z-Anatomy - The libre 3D atlas of anatomy - CC-BY-SA 4.0
upstreamSources.conditions: Only for Z-Anatomy's own work and the BodyParts3D meshes it adapts. Its License.txt lists five third-party models it 'used as reference/included and adapted', two of them non-commercial and two with no stated licence; each is a separate source below and none is cleared by Z-Anatomy's blanket statement. Z-Anatomy.zip's SHA-256 is null because its download did not complete from this runner; the git blob id content-addresses the same bytes, and W3 records the SHA-256 when it fetches the archive.
upstreamSources.evidence: License.txt and Readme.md at the pinned commit, 'LICENSE' and 'ATTRIBUTIONS' sections.

upstreamSources.title: Brain for Blender (cortical and subcortical meshes)
upstreamSources.attributionStatement: Brain for Blender, by Anderson Winkler, licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported, https://brainder.org/brain-for-blender
upstreamSources.conditions: The licence is cleared, and BY-SA 3.0 permits adaptations under BY-SA 4.0. That Z-Anatomy's 'Brainder' is this work is inferred from the name and the Destrieux/DKT-split cortex, not measured, so nothing may cite this source in place of zanatomy-undeclared-brain-materials until the geometry is matched.
upstreamSources.evidence: brainder.org page, 'License' section: 'The models in this page are by Anderson Winkler and are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License.'

upstreamSources.title: Z-Anatomy 'Brainder' and 'White matter' models (University of Washington), and any material not positively tied to Z-Anatomy or BodyParts3D
upstreamSources.holder: Unknown; attributed by Z-Anatomy to 'Brainder' and to 'White matter' from the University of Washington
upstreamSources.conditions: Covers every brain.glb structure whose primitives use the Z-Anatomy materials Brain, Brain-Inner or White matter (143), and the 3 whose only material is Temporal lobe (Corpus callosum, Midbrain x2): 146 of 437, including 126 of the 128 cortical structures. Temporal lobe otherwise appears only on the undeclared cortex, and nothing ties it to Z-Anatomy's own work or to BodyParts3D, so it is held fail-closed. Clears per structure only by (a) a geometric match against the Brainder meshes, which moves it to brainder-brain-for-blender, or (b) Z-Anatomy answering issue #10 with a licence. The White-matter-material structures (10) have no candidate source at all.
upstreamSources.evidence: Z-Anatomy License.txt lists both models without a licence. Upstream issue Z-Anatomy/Models-of-human-anatomy#10 (open, 2026-10-06, no reply) asks the same question; its reporter excludes all 174 objects with these materials from their CC BY-SA export.

upstreamSources.title: Cranial Nerves and Foramina
upstreamSources.holder: University of Dundee, Centre for Anatomy and Human Identification (CAHID); Sophia Lappe
upstreamSources.conditions: Z-Anatomy states CC BY 4.0. The primary page states none: the Sketchfab API returns an empty licence object for the model, and its description says it is based on BodyParts3D under CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan, which would make it share-alike at least. Recorded as share-alike for that reason. Clears by a licence statement from Dundee CAHID, or by W2 showing the brain.glb cranial nerves are BodyParts3D's own nerves.
upstreamSources.evidence: Z-Anatomy License.txt; Sketchfab model page and API, 2026-10-11.
